gloss: part of, link in a chain

definitions.gloss: part of, link in a chain
definitions.explanation: One component or phase within a larger connected series of actions, plans, or processes. Emphasizes that the item in question is not isolated but belongs to a broader whole.

examples.japanese: {教育|きょういく}の{一環|いっかん}として{行|おこな}う。
examples.english: Carry out as part of education.

examples.japanese: この{活動|かつどう}は{地域|ちいき}づくりの{一環|いっかん}です。
examples.english: This activity is part of community development.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}{促進|そくしん}の{一環|いっかん}として、{会社|かいしゃ}がヨガ{教室|きょうしつ}を{開|ひら}いている。
examples.english: As part of health promotion, the company is running yoga classes.

notes:
{一環|いっかん} literally means "one ring" or "one link" in a chain. It is almost always used in the pattern 〜の{一環|いっかん}として (as part of ~).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜の{一環|いっかん}として (as part of ~)
- 〜の{一環|いっかん}である (to be part of ~)
- {政策|せいさく}の{一環|いっかん} (part of a policy)
- {研修|けんしゅう}の{一環|いっかん} (part of training)
- {取|と}り{組|く}みの{一環|いっかん} (part of an initiative)

USAGE:
- Almost exclusively used with の{一環|いっかん}として or の{一環|いっかん}で
- Commonly found in formal and written Japanese, especially news and business contexts
- Not to be confused with {一貫|いっかん} (consistency, throughout), which has the same reading but different meaning
